subject: Sunrise AI — post-call recap, stakeholder commitments & next checkpoints
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Thompson <maya@sunrise.ai>, Evan Park <evan.park@sunrise.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sunrise AI — post-call recap, stakeholder commitments & next checkpoints

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a proposed mutual action plan so we have alignment on owners, dates, and success criteria. Please reply with any edits or missing stakeholders.

Top pain areas you mentioned
- Latency spikes on production endpoints (95th percentile > 500ms on peak queries) leading to degraded UX
- Monthly token spend unpredictability for large batch jobs
- Compliance requirement for customer data scoping (need VPC + audit logs)

Primary goals from our call
1) Run a 6-week pilot with a small production slice (100k requests/day equivalent) to validate 95th percentile latency < 200ms and per-token unit economics at scale
2) Verify VPC/on‑prem control plane for regulated data flows and KMS integration
3) Confirm model quality tradeoffs for quantized variants (no >3% drop on fuzz tests)

Proposed mutual action plan (high level) — please confirm owners and dates
- Milestone A — Scope & Sign-off (Target: Week 1 — by 2026-07-06)
  - Sunrise owners: Maya Thompson (Product), Evan Park (SRE)
  - Redwood owners: Vanessa Ortiz (AE), Jasmine Liu (Solutions)
- Milestone B — Security & Procurement Q&A (Target: Week 2–3 — by 2026-07-20)
  - Exchange SOC2 artifacts, network diagrams, and KMS requirements (attached: security-questions.xlsx)
- Milestone C — Pilot deployment & run (Target: Week 4–6 — 2026-07-21 to 2026-08-31)
  - Deploy dedicated capacity, run synthetic and live traffic, collect latency & cost metrics
- Milestone D — Exec review & procurement decision (Target: Week 7–8 — by 2026-09-14)
  - Executive review with business metrics; procurement to sign off on committed capacity or Dedicated contract

Deliverables from Redwood for pilot
- Pilot runbook and telemetry dashboard (shared Drive link)
- Pre-configured quantized model variant + test prompts
- Estimated committed-cost vs. observed-cost report after 2 weeks of traffic

Attachments: Sunrise-MPA-v1.pdf (draft MPA), security-questions.xlsx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/2143

Next actions
- Maya/Evan: please confirm owners above and whether the proposed dates are acceptable (reply by EOD Wednesday)
- Redwood: I will loop in Karthik Iyer (pricing) once we have procurement timing; Jasmine will start collecting SOC2 artifacts

Thanks — happy to take this to a short sync next week if you prefer a working session to finalize the MPA.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

- Owners: confirmed. I'll own Product-level sign-off; Evan will own SRE/network proof points.
- Dates: overall timeline looks good but can we shift the Pilot window earlier if we complete the security review quickly? Targeting start 2026-07-20 is preferable for us.
- SOC2 evidence: we'll share our compliance packet with you tomorrow; please confirm the exact artifact list you need (SSAE, encryption at rest docs, logging retention).
- Procurement: please include Karthik for pricing — we want to understand committed vs. burst pricing tiers up front.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Owners: Maya Thompson (Product) / maya@sunrise.ai
- Technical lead for pilot: Evan Park (SRE) / evan.park@sunrise.ai

We'll review the attached MPA and come back with edits by Thursday. If Redwood is able to provide SOC2 evidence and the network diagram within 48 hours, we can try to pull pilot start to 2026-07-20.
